acceptance_markers.name: Windows / settings
markers: STORAGE_REFUSAL_VERIFIED: empty and whitespace roots refused without repository mutations.

acceptance_markers.name: Windows / seven-day retained history
markers: SEVEN_DAY_HISTORY_PERFORMANCE_VERIFIED: seven real days, saturated checkpoint budgets, exact cold Login.
OUTGOING_NORMALIZATION_PERFORMANCE_VERIFIED: six exact-payload probes with unchanged validation and retention.
LAZY_NORMALIZATION_VERIFIED: sixteen matched processes preserved strict bytes, identity and 66 retained checkpoints.
HISTORY_REGION_SEARCH_VERIFIED: sixteen matched processes preserved exact proof strings/documents, journal, physical bytes/traces and 66 retained checkpoints.

limits: Matched proof learning and full port commit use FakeFileOps; these are not physical disk, public port preparation, gameplay or input-to-paint speedups.
Current source and tested merge differ in seven Markdown files only.
No native Windows renderer/accessibility or broad responsiveness acceptance is inferred.
Region-search measurements use real journal/storage protocol with FakeFileOps; they exclude physical disk, public port preparation, live UI capture and input-to-paint latency.
Mixed proof state is a synthetic first-51-of-66 seed, not a reconstruction of the exact Day7 first-reveal proof set.
Frozen reference provenance guards must be deliberately reviewed if the port changes outside the learned-region method; do not silently weaken them.

log_provenance.normalization: Decoded job log with LF line endings

retained_history_proof.fixture: 7 synthetic line and 7 synthetic manual checkpoint records/day, plus one real Slot 1 save and App loss/day. Public Schedule Done advances to Day 7. This is not an authored-dialogue playthrough.
retained_history_proof.timing_policy: Observations on one shared Windows runner; no speed threshold or physical input-to-paint guarantee.

timing_boundaries.manual_slot_save_us: Production prepare_backup_action(save, slot:1) plus commit_backup_action, including synchronous signal handlers.
timing_boundaries.login_us: Automated Title Login, Backup picker opening and Autosave selection, load consent, restore and awaited process frames.
timing_boundaries.phase_scopes: Each scope is inclusive. Parent and child scopes overlap and must not be summed; repeated phases inside one scope accumulate.
timing_boundaries.phase_collection: Save/load profiles include only labeled manual-save and Title Login measurement windows; startup and opening each daily Backup app before its save timer are excluded.
timing_boundaries.checkpoint_subphases: Version 2 document/schema/proof timers are nested inclusive measurements. History proof timers accumulate across entries; document proof lookup stops at its first miss. Profile instrumentation adds overhead and is not a speedup comparison.

parse_cache_comparison.control: Same checkout and retained user-data source, cloned into a new isolated process per variant. Only DWM_SAVE_PARSE_CACHE_DISABLED differs.
parse_cache_comparison.sampling: One cold Login per variant, fixed disabled-then-enabled order on one shared Windows runner; observational, not a repeated-sample or frame-time guarantee.

manual_prepare_comparison.control: Public prepare_backup_action and commit_backup_action with real storage, the same seeded Day7 journal, immutable capture fixture and a test-subclass fixed clock. Only the discarded eager journal copy in configured capture differs; parse cache and write validation memo are enabled in both.
manual_prepare_comparison.sampling: Eight alternating pairs / sixteen fresh isolated processes; identical prepared candidate, physical source files, target revision and pre-commit parser cache. Preparation timing covers only the public prepare_backup_action call, including immutable fixture copying, and excludes source cloning, journal seeding, proof generation, commit, live UI callbacks, issuer-flush callbacks and rendering. OS filesystem caches are not flushed.

lazy_normalization_comparison.sampling: Four alternating pairs per full/splice mode; sixteen fresh isolated processes. Each metric keeps five samples after two warmups. No timing threshold; OS caches are not flushed.
lazy_normalization_comparison.scope: Frozen eager helpers versus current lazy helpers on identical strict Day7 JSON. Both port seams use the same current strict outgoing schema and proofs. This is not a matched schema-build, physical-save, gameplay, or input-to-paint comparison.

history_region_search_comparison.sampling: Four alternating pairs per cold/mixed mode; sixteen fresh isolated processes. Each independent metric keeps five fresh-state samples after two warmups. No pooled/nested timing sum or timing threshold; OS caches are not flushed.
history_region_search_comparison.scope: Frozen original method versus current ordered cursor. Exact Day7 bytes and 66 history bundles; mixed has the same first 51 proofs and 15 misses. Direct learning plus complete port commit use real journal and storage protocol with FakeFileOps, not physical disk, public port preparation, gameplay or input-to-paint timing.
